decisions.rationale: NOA 2025 ($107,721), letter ($107,520) and pay stub support the stated $109,500.
An unexplained $10,000 cash deposit on 3 June is undocumented, and without it funds do not comfortably cover the down payment plus closing costs.
Appraisal value is subject to roof replacement completion and no completion certificate is on file, so the condition is not cleared.
Recent signed letterhead letter confirms permanent full-time employment since 2017, consistent with stated income.
